title: NormalizedEntity v1
description: Canonical normalized entity produced by the ingestion pipeline. Maps raw source records to the enterprise ontology with creation provenance, confidence scoring, and multi-source deduplication tracking.

canonical_id.description: Platform-wide unique identifier. Preferred URN format: urn:eoip:{domain}:{type}:{local-id}.

entity_type.description: Vertex label from the enterprise ontology (e.g. CodeFile, JiraIssue, Person).

graph_domain.description: Logical graph domain this entity belongs to (code, work, knowledge, identity, operations, evidence, compliance, design).

source_refs.description: References to the source events that contributed to this entity. Enables multi-source deduplication tracking.

creation_status.description: How this entity was created. DETERMINISTIC: direct extraction from structured source. INFERRED: ML/heuristic inference. HUMAN_CONFIRMED: manually verified.

confidence.description: Confidence that this entity is correctly mapped to the ontology. null when not computed.

properties.description: Domain-specific properties of this entity as defined by the ontology type hierarchy.
